Subject: Initial MAP & adoption timetable — LoomBridge pilot

Hi Iris / Samir,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited about the pilot potential. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template I drafted specifically for LoomBridge, plus a short slide deck that lays out the proposed 8-week adoption timetable and key acceptance gates.

High-level asks:
- Please review the MAP sections for stakeholders, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
- Confirm procurement timeline (Samir) so we can align the signing target.
- Any missing stakeholders I should add (your engineering lead / security contact)?

Links / attachments: MAP_Template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc) — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C-MAP-Template
Slides: MAP_Kickoff_Slides_v1.gslides

Proposed next steps:
1) You review and comment in the doc by EOD Wed (4/14).
2) Quick working session to align acceptance tests (30 min) — I included a Calendly link below; propose Thurs or Fri.
3) Doc updates + sign by end of next week if procurement timeline allows.

Attaching the draft for convenience (stubbed): MAP_Template_v1.gdoc, MAP_Kickoff_Slides_v1.gslides

Thanks — looking forward to feedback.

Connor O'Brien

Subject: Re: Initial MAP & adoption timetable — LoomBridge pilot

Connor — thanks for sending this over. I skimmed the MAP and the timeline looks reasonable. A few quick notes:

- Can we push the pilot start one week later? Our engineering lead (out next week) needs to be looped in.
- Procurement: Samir, can you confirm whether we need an SOW vs PO? If an SOW is required, the sign timeline will slip ~2 weeks.
- Acceptance criteria: add a short section for data retention and logs access — security will want that spelled out.

I added an inline comment in the doc on the metrics page. Happy to join a 30-min working session — I can do Fri 4/16 afternoon PT.

Best,
Iris
Head of Integrations | LoomBridge
iris.tan@loombridge.com

Thanks for the draft, Connor. I made a few edits in the doc — reordered the milestone cadence to allow for the engineering lead being back, and added an "Acceptance Test Plan" appendix with three test cases we typically use for a pilot (throughput sanity, latency regression, and golden prompt checks).

Samir — if LoomBridge prefers a PO instead of an SOW, we can scope the pilot as a 30-day evaluation under a PO with a neatly scoped SLA; if you need an SOW, we have a short template we can adapt. Either way, we should capture procurement preference in the MAP so sign timing is clear.

Connor — I also added a suggested list of Redwood owners for each milestone (PM, CS, Infra lead). If Iris is good with the edits I can push a v1.1 and attach simple acceptance test templates as a Google Sheet.
